proposed_widenings.name: passive_spell_grant family for ClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: The unit grants always-prepared spells at specific class levels with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three. A passive, level-gated spell-access family is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access variant for ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureEffect is currently GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. Neither represents spell access. The v4 atom grant_spell_access exists but is unreachable from any ClassFeatureMechanics path.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Draconic Spells table: Level 3 — Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath; Level 5 — Fear, Fly; Level 7 — Arcane Eye, Charm Monster; Level 9 — Legend Lore, Summon Dragon.

notes: Identical structural gap to warlock_fiend_spells_l3, cleric_life_domain_spells_l3, paladin_oath_of_devotion_spells_l3, and druid_circle_of_the_land_spells_l3 — all tier-2 units with the same always-prepared spell-list pattern. The new family needs: (1) a spell list that may be tiered by class level (threshold_tiers<SpellId[]> with axis=class), (2) no activation cost, resource, or reset cadence fields, (3) the grant_spell_access effect atom already in v4. Forcing this into 'activation' would be dishonest — there is no player-triggered action; spells become available passively on level acquisition.
